title: Learning to read on the job and his first break with Celestin and Bartholomew
summary: Harris learned to read around experienced musicians; joining Celestin was his first break, and with Bartholomew he recorded Domino, Joe Turner and others.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
